series_short_description: Pulled barefoot from Studio 205 into Vaeloria, Nolan (24), Gwen (19), and Mallory (24) build a life under twin moons.
series_description: At twenty-one, verbal autistic retail associate Nolan Lennox (5'7") missed every hidden signal when polite, five-foot-tall Tammy puffed out her chest over a Day-1 lunch at the Emerald Creek Mall food court and told him she was ready for everything—soon finding himself rushed into her un-air-conditioned trailer off Route 13. Two years and two breakups later, when Tammy impulsively drags twenty-three-year-old Nolan to the Norfolk Pathfinder terminal for a surprise ninety-nine-dollar Seattle trip without calling forty-eight hours ahead for a wheelchair lift, an interactive Story Crossroads places Nolan's fate in your hands: lock both wheelchair brakes in public and ride home to Emerald Creek, or endure the cross-country Pathfinder route until sister Gwen (6'1") and Shift Supervisor Mallory Walsh race west to bring him home. Across every Earth route, Nolan and Gwen rebuild together inside tiny rectangular Studio 205 at Norfolk's Harborview Towers with devoted girlfriend Mallory at Nolan's side—until a Friday-night amber rift pulls Nolan, Gwen, and Mallory barefoot into twin-moon Vaeloria to wake the Three-Ring Bronze Astrolabe and build an unhurried life together.
